notes.title: Upcoming update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41825130/abe3cf1a4d8882df13135b8b4f34c8a3d3a6fe71.gif

Hello, Wanderers! 

Not everything in life goes according to plan and for several obvious reasons, soon after the release of our game, work on this project slowed down. But despite the difficulties that arise we continue to work and are happy to inform you that the first major update is close at hand. 
 
We have captured a lot of old bugs, brought a pack of new ones, but most importantly we have prepared new mechanics and content for your wanderings. New monsters, items, locations and NPCs, all this and much more in the upcoming update. 

Wait for news and stay with us, Wanderers!
